Citizens Urge India, Pakistan PMs to Resume Bilateral Dialogue

Over 100 prominent citizens from India and Pakistan have jointly written an open letter to Prime Ministers Narendra Modi and Shehbaz Sharif. The letter calls for an end to hostilities and the resumption of bilateral dialogue and ties between the two nations. This initiative aims to foster peace and progress in the region.
